@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix : <http://www.example.org/ontology#> .

<http://www.example.org/ontology#edifact-invoice-story>
    rdf:type owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "EDIFACT Invoice Ontology" ;
    rdfs:comment "Ontology for representing UN/EDIFACT invoice structures, roles, and validation constraints." .

### Classes
:InterchangeEnvelope rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Interchange Envelope" ; rdfs:comment "The envelope containing EDIFACT messages." .
:Message rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Message" ; rdfs:comment "A generic message in the EDIFACT structure." .
:InvoiceMessage rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Invoice Message" ; rdfs:comment "An invoice message (INVOIC) in EDIFACT." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Message .
:Segment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Segment" ; rdfs:comment "A segment in a message, such as BGM or NAD." .
:CompositeDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Composite Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "A composite data element in a segment." .
:SimpleDataElement rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Simple Data Element" ; rdfs:comment "A simple data element within a composite." .
:Section rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Section" ; rdfs:comment "A section of an invoice message (header, detail, summary)." .
:HeaderSection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Header Section" ; rdfs:comment "Header section containing document dates and references." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Section .
:DetailSection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Detail Section" ; rdfs:comment "Detail section containing line items." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Section .
:SummarySection rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Summary Section" ; rdfs:comment "Summary section with totals and tax." ; rdfs:subClassOf :Section .
:LineItem rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Line Item" ; rdfs:comment "A line item in the detail section." .
:Item rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Item" ; rdfs:comment "An item sold in the invoice." .
:Price rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Price" ; rdfs:comment "The price of an item." .
:Organization rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization" ; rdfs:comment "An organization involved in the invoice." .
:AgentRole rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Agent Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role played by an organization (buyer, seller, delivery party, etc.)." .
:OrganizationRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Organization Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Pivot class for assigning roles to organizations within an invoice." .
:Address rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Address" ; rdfs:comment "An address associated with an organization role." .
:Identifier rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Identifier" ; rdfs:comment "An identifier for an organization, such as a GLN." .
:BusinessProcess rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Business Process" ; rdfs:comment "A business process to which an invoice can be assigned." .
:ValidationConstraint rdf:type owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Validation Constraint" ; rdfs:comment "A constraint for validation, e.g., SHACL rules for totals and identifiers." .

### Disjoint/DisjointUnion
:HeaderSection owl:disjointWith :DetailSection, :SummarySection .
:DetailSection owl:disjointWith :SummarySection .
:InvoiceMessage owl:disjointWith :BusinessProcess .
:Organization owl:disjointWith :Item .
:AgentRole owl:disjointWith :Organization .
:Section owl:disjointUnionOf ( :HeaderSection :DetailSection :SummarySection ) .

### Object Properties
:containsMessage rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contains message" ; rdfs:comment "Links an interchange envelope to messages it contains." ; rdfs:domain :InterchangeEnvelope ; rdfs:range :Message .
:containedInEnvelope rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "contained in envelope" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of containsMessage; links a message to its envelope." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range :InterchangeEnvelope ; owl:inverseOf :containsMessage .
:hasSection rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has section" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to its sections." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :Section .
:isSectionOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is section of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasSection; links a section to its invoice message." ; rdfs:domain :Section ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage ; owl:inverseOf :hasSection .
:hasSegment rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has segment" ; rdfs:comment "Links a message to its segments." ; rdfs:domain :Message ; rdfs:range :Segment .
:isSegmentOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is segment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasSegment; links a segment to its message." ; rdfs:domain :Segment ; rdfs:range :Message ; owl:inverseOf :hasSegment .
:hasCompositeElement rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has composite element" ; rdfs:comment "Links a segment to its composite data elements." ; rdfs:domain :Segment ; rdfs:range :CompositeDataElement .
:isCompositeElementOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is composite element of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasCompositeElement; links a composite element to its segment." ; rdfs:domain :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:range :Segment ; owl:inverseOf :hasCompositeElement .
:hasSimpleElement rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has simple element" ; rdfs:comment "Links a composite data element to its simple data elements." ; rdfs:domain :CompositeDataElement ; rdfs:range :SimpleDataElement .
:isSimpleElementOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is simple element of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasSimpleElement; links a simple data element to its composite." ; rdfs:domain :SimpleDataElement ; rdfs:range :CompositeDataElement ; owl:inverseOf :hasSimpleElement .
:involvesOrganization rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "involves organization" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to organizations involved." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:isInvolvedInInvoice rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is involved in invoice" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of involvesOrganization; links an organization to invoices." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage ; owl:inverseOf :involvesOrganization .
:hasLineItem rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has line item" ; rdfs:comment "Links a detail section to its line items." ; rdfs:domain :DetailSection ; rdfs:range :LineItem .
:isLineItemOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is line item of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasLineItem; links a line item to its detail section." ; rdfs:domain :LineItem ; rdfs:range :DetailSection ; owl:inverseOf :hasLineItem .
:soldItem rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "sold item" ; rdfs:comment "Links a line item to the item being sold." ; rdfs:domain :LineItem ; rdfs:range :Item .
:isSoldItemOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is sold item of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of soldItem; links an item to the line item where it's sold." ; rdfs:domain :Item ; rdfs:range :LineItem ; owl:inverseOf :soldItem .
:hasPrice rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has price" ; rdfs:comment "Links a line item to its price." ; rdfs:domain :LineItem ; rdfs:range :Price .
:isPriceOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is price of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasPrice; links a price to its line item." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range :LineItem ; owl:inverseOf :hasPrice .
:hasRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to an OrganizationRoleAssignment pivot class." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
:isRoleAssignmentOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role assignment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasRoleAssignment; links a role assignment to its invoice message." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage ; owl:inverseOf :hasRoleAssignment .
:roleOfOrganization rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "role of organization" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the organization." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Organization .
:hasOrganizationRoleAssignment rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has organization role assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of roleOfOrganization; links an organization to its role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; owl:inverseOf :roleOfOrganization .
:assignedRole rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned role" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the role." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :AgentRole .
:isAssignedRoleOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is assigned role of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedRole; links a role to its assignments." ; rdfs:domain :AgentRole ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; owl:inverseOf :assignedRole .
:roleAddress rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "role address" ; rdfs:comment "Links a role assignment to the address used in that role." ; rdfs:domain :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; rdfs:range :Address .
:isRoleAddressOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is role address of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of roleAddress; links an address to its role assignments." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range :OrganizationRoleAssignment ; owl:inverseOf :roleAddress .
:hasIdentifier rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has identifier" ; rdfs:comment "Links an organization to its identifier." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range :Identifier .
:isIdentifierOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is identifier of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasIdentifier; links an identifier to its organization." ; rdfs:domain :Identifier ; rdfs:range :Organization ; owl:inverseOf :hasIdentifier .
:assignedToProcess rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "assigned to process" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to a business process." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :BusinessProcess .
:isProcessAssignmentOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is process assignment of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of assignedToProcess; links a business process to invoice messages." ; rdfs:domain :BusinessProcess ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage ; owl:inverseOf :assignedToProcess .
:hasValidationConstraint rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "has validation constraint" ; rdfs:comment "Links an invoice message to a validation constraint." ; rdfs:domain :InvoiceMessage ; rdfs:range :ValidationConstraint .
:isValidationConstraintOf rdf:type owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "is validation constraint of" ; rdfs:comment "Inverse of hasValidationConstraint; links a validation constraint to invoice messages." ; rdfs:domain :ValidationConstraint ; rdfs:range :InvoiceMessage ; owl:inverseOf :hasValidationConstraint .

### Data Properties
:documentDate rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "document date" ; rdfs:comment "The date of the document." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:referenceNumber rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "reference number" ; rdfs:comment "The reference number of the document." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:organizationName rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "organization name" ; rdfs:comment "Name of the organization." ; rdfs:domain :Organization ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:addressLine rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "address line" ; rdfs:comment "Text of the address line." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:postalCode rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "postal code" ; rdfs:comment "Postal code for the address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:city rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "city" ; rdfs:comment "City of the address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:countryCode rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "country code" ; rdfs:comment "Country code of the address." ; rdfs:domain :Address ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:itemName rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "item name" ; rdfs:comment "Name of the item." ; rdfs:domain :Item ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:netPrice rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "net price" ; rdfs:comment "Net price of the item." ; rdfs:domain :Price ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:quantity rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "quantity" ; rdfs:comment "Quantity of the item in the line item." ; rdfs:domain :LineItem ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:invoiceAmount rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice amount" ; rdfs:comment "Total invoice amount." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:invoiceNumber rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "invoice number" ; rdfs:comment "Invoice number." ; rdfs:domain :HeaderSection ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:taxTotal rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "tax total" ; rdfs:comment "Total tax amount." ; rdfs:domain :SummarySection ; rdfs:range xsd:decimal .
:identifierValue rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "identifier value" ; rdfs:comment "The value of the identifier." ; rdfs:domain :Identifier ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:identifierType rdf:type owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:label "identifier type" ; rdfs:comment "The type of identifier, e.g., GLN." ; rdfs:domain :Identifier ; rdfs:range xsd:string .

### Property Characteristics
:containsMessage rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasSection rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:hasPrice rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:roleOfOrganization rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:assignedRole rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:roleAddress rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:documentDate rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:referenceNumber rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:organizationName rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:itemName rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:netPrice rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:quantity rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:invoiceAmount rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:invoiceNumber rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:identifierValue rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .
:identifierType rdf:type owl:FunctionalProperty .

### Restrictions and GCAs
:BuyerRole rdf:type :AgentRole ; rdfs:label "Buyer Role" ; rdfs:comment "Role of buyer in an invoice." .
_:orgRoleAssignmentBuyer rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :assignedRole ; owl:hasValue :BuyerRole ; rdfs:subClassOf :OrganizationRoleAssignment .
_:orgRoleAssignmentOrg rdf:type owl:Restriction ; owl:onProperty :roleOfOrganization ; owl:someValuesFrom :Organization ; rdfs:subClassOf :OrganizationRoleAssignment .

### Validation Constraint Example
:MandatoryGLNIdentifier rdf:type :ValidationConstraint ; rdfs:label "Mandatory GLN Identifier" ; rdfs:comment "Constraint that every organization must have a GLN identifier (for SHACL)." .
:InvoiceMessage :hasValidationConstraint :MandatoryGLNIdentifier .
